mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_bind_command(tenant_id,invitee_key,idempotency_key,request_hash,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{invitee},#{key},#{hash},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash AS requestHash,relation_id AS relationId FROM mk_referral_bind_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invitee_key=#{invitee} AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_subject_role(tenant_id,campaign_id,subject_key,subject_key_version,role,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{campaign},#{subject},#{keyVersion},'INVITEE',#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE row_version=row_version
mapper.select: SELECT role,participant_id AS participantId,relation_id AS relationId,subject_key_version AS keyVersion FROM mk_referral_subject_role WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND campaign_id=#{campaign} AND subject_key=#{subject} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_subject_role SET relation_id=#{r.relationId},updated_at=#{now},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{r.tenantId} AND campaign_id=#{r.campaignId} AND subject_key=#{subject} AND role='INVITEE' AND relation_id IS NULL AND participant_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_audit(tenant_id,audit_id,actor_id,action,resource_ref,reason,after_hash,trace_id,occurred_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{r.tenantId},#{auditId},#{actorId},'RELATION_BOUND',#{r.relationId},'首次有效归因固定，资格待评估',#{payloadHash},#{traceId},#{now},#{now},#{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_bind_command SET relation_id=#{relationId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invitee_key=#{invitee} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND relation_id IS NULL
